mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile: it showed how the threads and platelets work together to stop the leak.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was the least interesting part; it mainly set up the repair.

surprise.text: The vessel narrowed after the cut but was still leaking, and stopping the bleeding did not heal the skin above it.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and goals made the pairings understandable.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the open skin heals, since sealing the vessel only completed the first repair.
